A personal account from Initiate Elenn Tahl describing recurring dreams that Chief Historian Haruni interpreted as divine guidance. These visions foster belief in Qluud's influence as prophecy, suggesting the Ancient's corruption has begun to shape the minds of the Sunfire faithful.

A report from Daren Solvane detailing the potential uses of Merephet's Eclipse. His findings suggest the artifact holds immense value to the Ancients and would serve to advance Qluud's goals to spread dominion through the perversion of divine essence

A sealed parchment bearing the insignia of the Vaelune scholars and the mark of Aeterna's flame. Within, Azara has documented her findings on Chief Historian Haruni's behavior and the mounting signs of Qluud's corruption among the Sunfire ranks.
A simple, hand-woven net with years of wear in its knots. Frayed along the edges, but still serviceable for the shallow runs of Gloompool Grotto.
A well-used tin holding Soonu's collection of Gloomtrout flies. Shapes and threads chosen by tradition, each one tied to call the deep-pool trout to the line.
An exprimental extract created by Cleric Beyam. It is intended to fight the corruption.
